expires_today.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Return to New York by IDW
expires_today.long_description:
Grab a slice of pizza and dive into this giant bundle of comics starring everyone’s favorite sewer-dwelling reptile warriors, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!! Follow the Turtles as they clean up the streets of New York City, fighting off secret police, other mutants, and the nefarious Foot while making allies in unexpected places and working together as a family! Other highlights of this bundle include the Saturday Morning Adventures volumes and one-shots inspired by the charm and pandemonium of the ’90s cartoon, Turtle Power Pack adventures for younger readers, and both volumes of collected cover art from TMNT co-creator Kevin Eastman! There’s even more mutant mayhem to discover in this bundle of nearly 50 volumes and collections, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before August 12, 2027.

expires_today.title: The Humanoids Megabundle: Universes Unbound, Part 1 by Humanoids
expires_today.description: Comics like you’ve never seen them before
expires_today.long_description: A detective on the hunt for an ancient artifact. A universe ruled by futuristic technology. A climate crisis driven by swarms of insects. This is just a taste of what’s in store for you in this bundle of comics from Humanoids, full of old classics and new favorites! Rediscover classics from the master Alejandro Jodorowsky, from The Incal to The Technopriests to Son of the Gun and more! Try out new bestsellers like the mosquito-fueled climate change parable Dengue and the post-apocalyptic vampire survival tale The Last Ones! Immerse yourself in the imaginative stories and unique artwork collected in Humanoids’ 2000s relaunch of the iconic anthology Métal Hurlant! Those are just a few of what’s in this bundle of more than 30 great comic series from one of the best publishers operating today, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Reading Is Fundamental with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle
expires_today.description: Clear your calendar with Claude AI
expires_today.long_description:
Save development time, money, and sweat equity with The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle. Design unique characters, dynamic environments, and more with this curated 15+ course library. Led by AI Box Modeling with Blender in Claude Code and Digital Sculpting Basics with Blender in Claude Code, this bundle has everything you need to implement Claude AI into fundamental development processes with minimal friction. Reduce your development cycle with leading AI tools today, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before July 29th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Dark Horse 40th Anniversary Bundle, Presented by IGN
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Dark Horse with this bundle of the publisher’s most legendary comic series, brought to you by IGN! Enjoy fabulous omnibus editions of series starring the likes of Hellboy, the Witcher, and Vampire Hunter D! Enter a new era with the superhumans and villains of Dark Horse Heroes! Rediscover classic favorites like the epic fantasy saga Elfquest, new bestsellers like Vikings-meets-Succession drama Kill All Immortals, and totally unique genre mashups like Anthony Bourdain’s Hungry Ghosts! Collected together in this bundle are 40 of Dark Horse’s best series and omnibus editions, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support comic creator charity Hero Initiative with your purchase!

Founded in 1986, Dark Horse is one of the industry’s leading publishers of comics, graphic novels, books, manga, and collectibles. Known for championing creator-first storytelling, Dark Horse has published landmark titles including Hellboy, Sin City, The Umbrella Academy, and Black Hammer, as well as acclaimed licensed works based on Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Witcher, The Last of Us, and Critical Role. The company also helped define manga publishing in North America with classics such as Lone Wolf and Cub, Trigun, Berserk, and Blade of the Immortal.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate AI & Machine Learning Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Design the ultimate agentic sidekick, digital assistant, and beyond with the hottest AI bundle of the summer! This comprehensive course collection provides a practical journey from machine learning fundamentals to advanced agentic AI and generative AI development. You’ll master core ML concepts like regression, classification, cross-validation, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, neural networks, CNNs, and PCA through theory and hands-on labs. In a Humble Exclusive, members unlock access to Amazon Bedrock for building chatbots and more! Plus, your purchase helps support Coral Guardian!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before August 13th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Twin Sails Interactive 2026
expires_tomorrow.description: A new spin on the board games you love
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Love board games but don’t love keeping track of all those pesky pieces? We have the solution: all the games you love in digital form, to play on your console or PC! We’ve teamed up with Twin Sails Interactive for a massive digital bundle of board games and add-ons, from classic fantasy tales, sci-fi adventures, horror stories, and beyond. Scheme your way to the Iron Throne in A Game of Thrones: The Board Game! Enter the mysterious, eldritch world of H.P. Lovecraft in Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace! Gather resources and conquer the Red Planet in Terraforming Mars! Lead a band of mercenaries through the dangerous lands of Gloomhaven! There’s a lot more to explore in this bundle of fan-favorite digital board games and expansion packs, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the gene therapy outreach of FOXG1 Research Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before August 12th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Point Click Package
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Unlock retro vibes galore with the Point & Click Package Bundle! Experience Syberia - Remastered, the fully updated adventure of protagonists Kate and Oscar. The rich world of this first entry mixes point-and-click gameplay with immersive visuals and gripping storytelling for a whole new generation. Or try Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy - Digital Deluxe Upgrade, a mysterious quest for the Great White Birds in a land full of secrets to uncover! Rediscover one of the truly great genres of early gaming and help support Xperience Studios with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 12th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Framing, Carpentry, and Fine Woodworking by Taunton Press
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Interested in trying out woodworking but never knew where to start? A veteran carpenter looking to pick up some new skills? This is the bundle for you, chock-full of resources and manuals that will help you achieve your loftiest woodworking dreams! Learn the ins and outs of home renovation! Get a crash course in framing a house! Fill your dream home with cabinetry, tables, and chairs made by you! There’s a certain satisfaction in making the things you use every day, and this bundle will teach you exactly how to bring your woodworking projects to life. Grab these instructional ebooks now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Blade Runner Collection by Titan Comics
expires_tomorrow.description: Discover the next chapter of Blade Runner’s story
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Are you on the side of humanity or technology? Lose yourself in the renowned Blade Runner comic series in this bundle from Titan Comics! Follow the continued stories of Rick Deckard and Roy Batty alongside new original characters in thrilling graphic novels and comics like Blade Runner Black Lotus: Las Vegas #1 and Blade Runner 2019: Vol. 1: Los Angeles, and see a new side of this iconic dystopian universe. Uncover what’s new with the Tyrell Corporation, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Audio Alchemy Vol. 2: The Ultimate Game Dev Audio Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description:

Explore a variety of genres, from funk to electronic and everything in between. Get the assets you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support Children's Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!
